messages:
maria-l: Quick heads-up — doing an RBAC sweep of the Console role matrix. Ran into an oddity where users with the 'viewer' role can still open the Usage tab when a feature-flag is enabled. :thinking:
chris-k: repro steps? what FF and where in the stack? :eyes:
maria-l: steps: 1) create org + invite as viewer 2) enable 'new-usage-explorer' flag for org 3) open console -> usage. Viewer can hit the timeseries page and export CSV button is visible.
chris-k: can you paste the policy eval log?
maria-l: pasted below — the permission check order looks inverted:
```
permission_check(user.role=viewer, resource=usage.export) -> backend: allowed fallback true
policy_stack: [ui-gating:deny, api-policy:allow] -> final=allow
```
anika-p: :rotating_light: wait — we recently changed the evaluation short-circuit to prefer API policy results over UI gates to reduce roundtrips. sounds like that change regressed intended UI gating.
devsec-bot: Automated audit alert: missing audit-log entry for usage.export by user=org_viewer_42 at 2490012345. Severity=medium.
samir: I think root cause is ordering + missing audit emission in the fallback path. quick patch: ensure UI-level deny takes precedence and add audit emit on any allow from fallback. pseudo-diff:
```diff
- if api_policy.allows(resource): return allow
- else if ui_gate.allows(user): return allow
+ if ui_gate.explicit_deny(user, resource): return deny
+ if api_policy.allows(resource): emit_audit("policy:api", user, resource); return allow
```
lee: pls also add unit tests for the precedence matrix + a regression test for feature flag combos.
anika-p: Agreed. Also we need to check KMS key rotation impact — yesterday's rotation touched the session token issuer and there was a gap in logs. If audit emit runs after token validation, rotated tokens might have skipped audit.
maria-l: good catch. ops-bot, any infra windows that overlap with the rotation?
ops-bot: infra-note: KMS rotation completed 2490009000-2490010000 UTC, no known failed jobs recorded. Will triage logs on request.
chris-k: action plan: 1) revert short-circuit change in auth-eval (hotfix branch) 2) add audit emission in fallback paths 3) add unit + e2e testing for UI gating + FF combos 4) validate KMS rotation audit linkage 5) schedule canary deploy to staging -> then prod.
anika-p: tagging @security oncall for potential incident: this could be an exposure (viewer exporting org usage). recommend we mark it P2 and run quick ACL audit for last 24h.
devsec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-84, severity=P2, assigned=anika-p, timeline_link=https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-84
samir: I'll open the PR for the fix and include the test matrix. draft title: "auth: prioritize ui-gates + audit on fallback"
maria-l: thx. Samir, pls include a small migration step-note for telemetry: add audit events retroactively for suspected window (scripts live in ops/tools/audit_replay).
lee: assign reviewers: chris-k + anika-p. add unit tests and a smoke test that flips the FF in CI.
ops-bot: rolling window scheduled for canary: staging 2490016000, prod 2490020000. notify if timing conflicts with other deploys.
chris-k: once PR is up i'll run a quick static check for any additional permission evaluation shortcuts.
anika-p: also reach out to legal if data export by viewers occurred in prod — might need disclosure if customer-sensitive.
maria-l: noted. I'll run the ACL audit for last 36h and post summary here.
chris-k: good catch, thanks everyone. moving to action items. :white_check_mark:
